# Bulk alpha-quartz calculation

units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data quartz.data

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/REAXFF/ffield.reax Si O

fix QEQ all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1.0e-6 reaxff

replicate 2 2 2

minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable E equal pe
run 0
print "Bulk_energy = ${E}"

# Surface alpha-quartz calculation

units real
atom_style full
boundary p p s

read_data quartz.data

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/REAXFF/ffield.reax Si O

fix QEQ all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1.0e-6 reaxff

replicate 2 2 2

minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable E equal pe
run 0
print "Surface_energy = ${E}"
